paragraphs: TrueComp sells workforce analytics built for public sector human resources and finance teams. The pitch is aimed at agencies whose compensation decisions still rest on dated reports and static spreadsheets.

The company says it gathers workforce data from across levels of United States government and presents it in an easy-to-use format for those professionals. Agencies supply plan provisions, salary schedules, and employee census information for loading into the system. The software is fully cloud-based, so there is nothing to download. Beyond benchmarking, the line covers labor negotiation and compensation services for the public sector, and tailored training sessions are part of the package.

The company dates its work equipping public agencies to 2014. It states that over 1,000 state and local government agencies across the country rely on it. Published customer case studies include county work on pension liabilities and labor negotiations.

quote.text: Workforce analytics built exclusively for public sector HR and Finance.
